MRCY was moved from the S&P 400 to replace it as it was more representative of the small cap market space.<ref>{{cite web |url = https://www.spglobal.com/spdji/en/documents/indexnews/announcements/20230816-1465605/1465605_600arnc.pdf |title = Chesapeake Energy Set to Join S&P MidCap 400 |date = August 1, 2023 |access-date = August 21, 2023}}</ref>
